metricDefinitions.rawAccuracy: Correct raw candidates / present ground-truth values; absence is reported separately.
metricDefinitions.coverage: Accepted present values / all present values, including registration failures.
metricDefinitions.accuracy: Correct accepted values / ALL accepted values; accepted phantom colors count as errors.
metricDefinitions.buckets: High/Medium/Uncertain refer to present values; confidenceAllDecisions also includes absent colors.
metricDefinitions.missing: Raw candidate and final abstention are retained separately; null is never score zero.
